newsitem.title: USA: BPA leaves off-peak power unchanged through Monday.
newsitem.headline: BPA leaves off-peak power unchanged through Monday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left its prices for firm off-peak power unchanged through Monday from offers for Friday delivery.
BPA continued to hold off from offering firm or non-firm power during peak and shoulder hours for Saturday and Monday.

BPA did, however, offer firm power for high load hours on Sunday at $10.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) to a limit of 500 megawatts. Also on Sunday, non-firm power from 0900-2200 was offered at $10.50 per MWh.
Firm off-peak power was offered at $8.50 per MWh for Saturday, Sunday, and Monday delivery, unchanged from offers for Friday.
BPA offered non-firm power at $8.50 per MWh during hours ending 0100-0700 and 2300-2400 PST for Saturday, 0100-0800 and 2300-2400 PST on Sunday and 0100-0500 and 2400 PST on Monday.
Prices for non-firm power at 0600 and 2300 on Monday were set at $9.00 per MWh.
